review.ownMeasures: You measured this revision: someone else confirms it (nobody confirms their own measures).
review.notNow: This revision cannot be reviewed now: read the record again.

fittings.notNow: Fittings cannot be booked or recorded for this rider now.

problem.unavailable: The factory system could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: Your roles do not allow this.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been removed.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.contract: This page and the factory system do not match: reload the page.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problem.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: read it again, then try again.
problem.invalid: The factory system refused this as it is: check what you typed.
problem.stepUp: This needs a fresh authenticator code.

problem.alreadyMeasured: This rider has measures of this garment type already: open their profile and record a new revision there.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to rider profiles
noAccess.body: Rider measurements are personal data: the sales and production manager roles see them (the right to see rider measurements).

off.template: Made-to-measure has not started for template {template}: nothing of it is checked, and no unit is quoted or fitted until it is started.
off.noTemplate: This garment type has no measurement template: the template names the points to measure.
off.none: Made-to-measure has not started for any measurement template
off.noneBody: Rider profiles can be recorded, sent by link and reviewed. A unit is quoted, ordered or fitted only once made-to-measure is started for its template (the owner starts it, per template).
off.someBody: The other garment types stay off: their profiles are recorded and reviewed, but no unit is quoted or fitted.
off.recordBody: The measures can still be recorded, sent by link and reviewed. The owner starts made-to-measure per template in Products › Sizes & measurements › Measurement templates.

list.intro: Riders’ body measures per garment type, the factory review, fittings and the worksheet for made-to-measure units.
list.noMatchBody: Clear a filter to see more riders.
list.emptyBody: No riders yet: record a rider’s first measurements, or send a measurement link from a profile.
list.foot: Each row is a rider’s newest revision of one garment type; older revisions stay on the profile.

hint.waiting: Newest revisions the factory has not reviewed
hint.needMore: The factory asked the rider or dealer for more
hint.outside: Riders whose newest measures make a unit outside its style's certified range (— while made-to-measure has not started)
hint.fittings: Riders with a fitting booked or done this week
hint.old: Measured more than 12 months ago: measure again before a repeat order

review.title: Review measurements · revision {revision}
review.flagged: Points flagged by the plausibility checks
review.outsideLine: {value} is outside {range}: the measurer checked it and kept it.
review.nothingFlagged: Nothing is flagged: every value is inside its range and no rule is broken.
review.rulesOff: Made-to-measure has not started for {template}: only the plausible ranges are checked.
review.messageHint: The rider or dealer reads these words

held.note: Say what more is needed: the rider or dealer reads it.

review.notify: Mail these words to the rider or dealer now
review.notifyHint: Sent from the company’s mailbox; the reply reaches the sender.
review.noAddress: No address is known: the words are kept on the profile only.
review.confirmMeans: Confirming lets the orders waiting for these measures go on.

done.confirmedOrders_one: The measures are confirmed: {count} order went on ({orders}).

done.needMoreNotMailed: More was asked, but the mail could not go: no address or no mail identity. Tell the rider yourself.
done.needMoreKept: More was asked; the words are kept on the profile (not mailed).

problem.conflict: This revision changed meanwhile (reviewed, or a newer one): read it again.

live.linkAnswered: A measurement link was answered: a new revision waits for the factory review.
live.linkAnsweredHere: The rider sent new measurements by the link: a new revision waits for the factory review.

form.rulesOff: Made-to-measure has not started for this template: its rules are not checked while you type (the plausible ranges still are).
form.flags_one: The measures break {count} rule of the template
form.flags_other: The measures break {count} rules of the template
form.noPoints: This template has no points to measure yet.
form.basicHint: Optional; the certificate’s made-to-measure check asks the height

problem.outside: {point} {value} is outside {range}: check it, then tick “I checked it”.

problem.notAPoint: Not a point of this template.

problem.contact: Not an active contact of this customer.
problem.garment: This garment type has no measurement template.
problem.fix_one: {count} field needs a look before saving.
problem.fix_other: {count} fields need a look before saving.

new.checkStyleHint: An MTM style: the base size the measures suggest for its range

meas.compareHeld: One revision only: nothing to compare yet.

reviewPanel.noAddress: No address is known to mail “need more” to: the words are kept on the profile.

range.noStyles: No MTM style uses this garment type yet

range.notThisStyle: This style cannot be made to measure for this rider

range.alterationsOk: Every point stays within its limits.

finding.GARMENT_TYPE: The rider was measured for another garment type than {template}.

photos.noneBody: No revision of {rider} came with photos. Send a measurement link with photos required.
photos.keptUntilShipped: Deleted 90 days after the garment ships
photos.stripped: A copy without its location data.

held.notNow: Not possible for this outcome now.

book.title: Book a fitting
book.invite: Send the invite (.ics) to the rider
book.inviteHint: The rider gets a calendar invite and a reminder the day before.
book.inviteHintNoReminder: The rider gets a calendar invite. No automatic reminder: switched off in Sales settings.
book.noInviteHint: No mail: tell the rider yourself.

held.past: A fitting is booked ahead: not in the past.

done.invited: Fitting booked; the invite was sent.

warn.fitterBusy: The fitter is already booked at that time.
warn.noAddress: No address is known for the rider: the invite was not sent.
warn.other: The booking has a warning: open it to check.

problem.conflict: This cannot be booked now: made-to-measure may not have started for the template, or the rider’s measures changed.

appt.moveInvite: Send the update to the rider

held.closed: It is {status}: only its notes change now.
held.noAddress: No address is known for the rider.
held.notNow: Not possible now (made-to-measure may be off for the template, or no right).

problem.conflict: The appointment changed meanwhile: it was read again.

result.lineHint: An alteration moves this line’s date
result.noLines: No order line made to this rider yet
result.changesHint: Signed, in the point’s unit (“+2.0”, “−1.5”); leave empty what stays.
result.daysHint: The unit’s date moves by them when it is sent to alteration
result.daysNoLine: Moves a date only with an order line
result.remakeHint: A remake is made from the unit’s return; record the new measures as a new revision.

held.what: Pick the fitting or the order line fitted.
held.changes: A change per point is a signed number, not zero.

problem.change: A signed number with at most 4 digits and 2 decimals (“+2.0”).
problem.point: {point}: the change cannot be taken (the revision has no measure there, or it is too large).
problem.repairRight: Sending to alteration needs the right to manage repairs.

result.recordedClosed: Outcome recorded: {verdict}; the fitting is closed done.

altered.moved: Alteration {number} opened; the unit’s date moved from {from} to {to}.
altered.notMoved: Alteration {number} opened; the unit’s date did not move (no order line date, lines fixed, or no right).

result.named: Revision {revision} is named as the new measures.

link.emailHint: The rider has no contact address: type one, or give the link yourself

see.points_other: {count} points to measure, guided one by one with how to measure each.

quote.baseSizeHint: Empty: the size the measures point to

activity.noThread: Your roles do not read record threads: the rider's notes and messages are not shown here.
